title: Integrating a SaaS Application for Workflow Automation

blocks.text: You can integrate different SaaS applications with Workflow Automation for the Business Insights service.
To integrate a SaaS application, you can:

blocks.item: Ensure Workflow Automation is enabled for an already added application
To enable Workflow Automation for an application:
Locate the application for which you want to enable Workflow Automation, and click the Edit icon.

blocks.text: The SaaS application is successfully integrated with Workflow Automation for the Business Insights service. To learn more, see What Is Workflow Automation?
